newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Dec 3.

text.p: Dow Corning proposed a $3 billion plan to get out of bankruptcy-court protection, the Wall Street Journal reported.
- Merrill Lynch named Herbert Allison Jr. president and chief operating officer.
- Prosecutors are expected to ask a federal grand jury to indict two recently-departed ADM executives on criminal antitrust charges.
- A U.S. District Judge tossed out the federal conviction ofCharles Keating Jr.
- The latest economic data bolstered expectations for solid fourth-quarter growth.
- Chrysler posted a 1 percent increase in monthly light-vehicle sales.
- Central banks are fueling recent record runs by world stock markets.
- A federal jury found a pattern of bias against blacks at electronics retailer Circuit City Stores and awarded nearly $290,000 to two employees.
- General Motors named two high-profile executives as directors.
- Great Western Financial plans a restructuring that includes cuting 800 jobs.
- Microsoft said it plans to offer its first preferred stock in a $750 million issue aimed at broadening its already mammoth investor base.

- Despite various indications of a strengthening economy, the price of the benchmark 30-year treasury bond was down 2/32 for a bond with a $1,000 face value at 101 25/32 in late trading Mo 536870913 1852072313
